meta.note: Per-vehicle PNG layers. The DEFS here are complete geometry (rect 0,0,w,h at 1×, ground-contact anchor, footprint 1×1, moving) so `loadVehicleLayers` can install the sprite straight into the table the renderer reads — the branded lorries need no cell in assets/iso-atlas, and the legacy truck_goods_* sheet art stays as the boot fallback.
